title: Fantastic tour !!
text: We had the best time! The tour was fantastic and our guide was knowledgeable and kind. We loved walking around, trying specialty coffees, seeing various art galleries, and learning all about art history. We highly recommend!
author: John_P

title: Great tour, Amazing tour guide
text: Silvanna is such an amazing tour guide! She had a wealth of information about Barcelona art history and it was great to see the gothic art mixed with the art of today. It is also clear that the owners and workers at the coffee shops and art galleries really liked her (with good reason). I took this tour about a month ago and have been raving about it ever since. Make sure to ask her about her other tours!
author: Samantha_V

title: Thank you Silvana!
text: Thank you to Silvana for the great tour! We just moved to Barcelona and have begun taking tours to learn more about this fascinating city. This tour was so different from anything else we have seen. The information was exciting and we look forward to exploring more. Silvana is very knowledgeable about the coffee and art scene in Barcelona and we highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for a different kind of tour.
author: Orpha_C
